title: KCP endeavor_promotion_cancel result (the released pair)
description: One endeavor promotion: the paired intent/slot state, the append-only attempts, and the committed link.

state.description: EndeavorFormationIntent.state, byom §16.3 verbatim. linked and canceled are terminal; timeout, absence, authentication expiry, binding rotation, an unverified historical lookup, or ambiguous never releases the paired slot.

EndeavorFormationSlot.state, §16.3 verbatim. Exactly four things release a slot: a pre-send cancel, a verified non-reexecuting tombstone, a verified historically fenced absence, and a committed ExternalLink. There is no timeout release.

generation.description: The slot generation every paired intent/slot CAS runs under.

slot.description: The paired uniqueness slot. UNIQUE(realm_id, requested_by_principal, client_formation_key) WHERE state != released, enforced in code as a partial index.

canonical_byom_command_digest.description: Covers ONLY the stable KoveeEndeavorFormCommand bytes — never attempt id/nonce, authentication observation/proof, transport request id, or send time (§16.3). Class portable_public: both parties recompute it, which is what makes 'the request field can only match the server value' a machine check.

idempotency_domain_digest.description: The IdempotencyDomain digest, always the keyed scope_erasure_safe class over the per-Society index key (§14.2; PROFILE §5, D-R0-1).

attempts.description: The APPEND-ONLY per-send envelopes: resolving an intent never rewrites an earlier attempt's send or authentication evidence (§16.3).

external_link.description: Present once the ExternalLink committed the exact result digest; link creation is idempotent over that digest.

byom_result.description: The UNMODIFIED KoveeEndeavorFormResult envelope byom signed. SQL loss after byom's commit is recovered from exactly these bytes.

digestHex.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256/HMAC value of a §11.8 typed digest; the digest type/domain is fixed by the schema field holding it (§11.8: a bare 32-byte value cannot be substituted across digest fields).

class.description: Family digest class (byom family-vectors PROFILE §6, D-R0-1). Governed-work host records use scope_erasure_safe: one protected per-realm governance key, so destroying it erases verifiability of the whole governance scope, never one row.

key_ref.description: Key id for the keyed erasure classes; raw HMAC keys, per-object secrets, and salts are never part of a DigestRef.

digestRef.description: Typed family DigestRef (PROFILE §6.1), never an unlabelled hash. The class/algorithm pairing and the key_ref-presence rule for the keyed classes are enforced in code (they are a cross-member constraint the closed object cannot express here).

endeavor_ref.description: byom's Endeavor id, carried verbatim and never re-owned.

source_cursor.description: byom's own continuation cursor, preserved verbatim.

externalLink.description: The Kovee ExternalLink committing the exact result digest (§16.3 table row 13); idempotent over its own digest.

attempt_nonce.description: Globally unique per attempt, and EXCLUDED from the canonical command digest — so a retry preserves the semantic bytes and the idempotency domain while replacing only the expiring proof/binding envelope (§16.3).

state.description: EndeavorFormationAttempt.state, §16.3 verbatim. reply_received, reconciled, and canceled are terminal.

sent_at.description: Set the moment bytes MAY first leave Kovee. prepared and canceled carry none — a cancel happens only before that point.

formationAttempt.description: One immutable authentication/transport envelope per send.

identifier.description: Opaque identifier, at most 128 bytes (§11.8); visible-ASCII alphabet is a K0 extraction decision (spec/schemas/README.md).

safeNonNegativeInteger.description: I-JSON safe integer (§11.8 rejects unsafe integers).

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 date-time (recorded K0 extraction decision, spec/schemas/README.md item 7); format: date-time additionally requires semantic calendar validity (R0 KENV-05).
